bf_wave_velocity.description: wave velocity, e.g. 346.0 for speed of sound in air

bf_freq__lower.description: lower boundary of beam former work frequency

bf_freq__upper.description: upper boundary of beam former work frequency

bf_cov_snapshots_window_size.description: snapshots window size to fit covariance matrix

bf_cov_freq_average_index.description: frequency average index to fit covariance matrix

dma__buffer_size.description: AXI DMA descriptor buffer size, the sampling points of the frame can be calculated as [dma__buffer_size] / 4

queue__circular_buffer_queue_size_max.description: MAX size of circular buffer data queue

queue__result_queue_size_max.description: MAX size of result data queue
